facts.fact: The National Broadband Policy gazetted 14 August 2020 (published year-dated; the policy itself is a broadband subsector instrument) says it is built on and supports the objectives of the Overarching ICT Policy 2009, which it treats as in place; the document does not describe that policy's scope.

note: The broadband policy itself is a subsector instrument and gives no fact; the passages end before its implementation sections.
